title: indul and érkezik: Departing and Arriving

sections.title: Where from, where to
sections.content: indul ("to depart") and érkezik ("to arrive") are the two verbs you build a whole train announcement out of. indul pairs with -ból/-ből to say where a train is leaving FROM; érkezik pairs with -ba/-be to say where it's arriving TO. Put them together and you can describe any journey: honnan indul, és hova érkezik.

sections.title: indul and érkezik with a place
rows: which platform does it arrive at?

items.spanish: A vonat Bécsből indul, és Rómába érkezik.
items.english: The train departs from Vienna and arrives in Rome.

sections.content: vágányra in the table uses -ra/-re, not -ba/-be — a platform is a surface you arrive ON, not a space you arrive INTO, so it follows the -on/-en/-ön set like asztalon does.
